ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_HelpScaryPo:
LOSTELLE: Whimper… Sniff… Oh! Please, help!
A scary POKéMON appeared there a little while ago.
It kept scaring. It made LOSTELLE scared.
I'm too scared to move! But I want to go home…
ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_HereItComes:
Oh! Here it comes again! No! Go away! It's scaring me!
Waaaaaaah! I want my daddy!
ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_ThankYouHav:
Ohh! That was so scary! Thank you!
LOSTELLE came to pick some BERRIES.
You can have this!
ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_LetsGoHome:
What's your name?
LOSTELLE's scared, so can I go with you to my daddy's house?
Okay! Let's go home!
ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_BerryPouchI: Your BERRY POUCH is full. I guess you don't want this.
